paper_idea: AlphaBench frames LLM alpha mining as formula generation from price and volume operators, then portfolio evaluation by Sharpe and related metrics.

AlphaPROBE treats alpha mining as DAG-guided factor evolution, selecting promising parents while preserving factor-pool diversity and stability.
QuantAgent is a price-driven multi-agent HFT system centered on short-horizon technical indicators, chart patterns, trend state, and risk-aware execution.
FinCon uses manager/analyst hierarchy plus dual-level risk control, including CVaR-style monitoring, for portfolio decisions.
Trading-R1 frames trading as reasoning/RL over market state and rewards; the JKP proxy tests a risk-adjusted trend/reversal reward signal.
AlphaForgeBench evaluates LLMs as quantitative researchers generating executable alpha factors and factor-based trading strategies.
LiveTradeBench evaluates live multi-asset portfolio allocation under price/news uncertainty with explicit risk-return allocation decisions.
DeepFund models a multi-agent fund workflow with fundamental, technical, policy/news, insider-style analysts, portfolio management, and risk control.
TradeTrap is primarily a robustness/stress-test framework; the in-spirit proxy tests the conservative safety/liquidity posture implied by its mitigation concerns.

FactorMiner uses modular skills and experience memory to build a diverse low-redundancy library of formulaic alpha factors.

Alpha-GPT is a human-AI interactive formulaic alpha mining system that summarizes and modifies top-performing symbolic alphas.
Alpha-GPT 2.0 expands interactive alpha mining into alpha modeling and analysis over a full quantitative investment workflow.
Chain-of-Alpha is described as chained formula generation and optimization using market data and backtest feedback.
FactorMAD is a multi-agent debate framework for interpretable stock alpha factor mining.
AlphaAgentEvo frames alpha mining as self-evolving agentic reinforcement learning that refines seed alphas through reward-guided trajectories.
LLMFactor extracts explainable factors from text/news and historical prices to predict stock movement.
FactorEngine turns domain knowledge and reports into executable factor programs, with closed-loop verification and portfolio feedback.
FinAgent is a multimodal, tool-augmented generalist trading agent with diversified trading and risk-aware tool use.
FLAG-Trader fuses LLM agents with gradient/RL-style policy optimization for sequential trading decisions.
Janus-Q is an event-driven trading framework that models heterogeneous event impact and optimizes reward-gated trading decisions.
Trade in Minutes decouples strategy development from rapid execution, using technical indicators, strategy adaptation, and risk control in volatile markets.
MountainLion coordinates multimodal RAG agents for price forecasting, news-driven reasoning, risk evaluation, and strategic allocation.

AlphaCrafter combines mined factors, regime screening, and risk-constrained trading; this proxy tests a diversified value-quality-momentum-low-risk factor ensemble.
AlphaAgents risk-neutral portfolios emphasize valuation plus fundamentals/growth/momentum.
AlphaAgents risk-averse portfolios emphasize lower volatility and stable fundamentals.
MarketSenseAI factor analysis discusses value and momentum loadings, with fundamentals and price dynamics reinforcing selection.
FinVision prompts prioritize holding strong upward trends, buying dips within uptrends, and risk management.
QuantAgent appendix includes a VolatilityBreakoutSignal based on high breaking above a threshold relative to ATR.
QuantAgent appendix includes ThreeSoldier candlestick-style trend continuation signals with volume/body-size confirmation.
MM-DREX dynamically routes trend, reversal, breakout, and risk/positioning experts.
Benjamin Graham-style defensive value: cheap, liquid, profitable, low leverage, low risk.
Warren Buffett-style quality compounder: durable quality/profitability/growth with low leverage.
Joel Greenblatt-style magic formula: earnings yield plus business quality/return on capital.
Joseph Piotroski-style F-score: profitability, operating cash flow, accrual quality, leverage, issuance, and asset turnover.
Edward Altman-style distress avoidance: earnings/cash/debt coverage and downside-risk control.
GuruAgents combines multiple investment-guru sleeves; this is an equal-weight score ensemble of the five guru proxies.
proxy_formula: average Graham, Buffett, Greenblatt, Piotroski, Altman proxy scores
